question: Should native Signal quote replies ship as replyToMode=all by default for existing Signal users, or should the new behavior be quieter or opt-in?
rationale: The implementation is channel-local and plausible, but the default changes user-visible Signal reply presentation and repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive maintainer choices.

options.title: Confirm all-mode default
options.body: Keep the current implementation and document that existing Signal auto-replies will use native quote metadata by default when available.

options.title: Use a quieter default
options.body: Change the default to off or first and let users opt into all-mode quoting through the new Signal config fields.

options.title: Pause for quote-work consolidation
options.body: Keep the draft open until the overlapping broad and inbound-only Signal quote PRs are reconciled into one maintainer-approved direction.

recommendation.title: Confirm all-mode default
recommendation.body: Keep the current implementation and document that existing Signal auto-replies will use native quote metadata by default when available.

likelyOwner.reason: Jesse owns this draft and has recent merged Signal work, so he is the clearest owner for confirming or changing the default behavior.
